findings.issue: react-markdown + remark-gfm bundled into the critical chat input chunk (~50KB gzipped) for a preview feature
findings.impact: Users who never open markdown preview still download the markdown parser. On mobile connections this adds significant latency.
findings.fix: Lazy-load the MarkdownPreview component via next/dynamic with ssr:false, only importing react-markdown when the preview toggle is activated.

findings.issue: Channel page is a client component with no route-level code splitting for sub-features (thread panel, media room, search)
findings.impact: All sub-feature bundles are loaded upfront even when never used (e.g. MediaRoom LiveKit imports on channels without calls).
findings.fix: Wrap ThreadPanel, MediaRoom, and SearchBar in next/dynamic() lazy imports with appropriate loading states.

findings.issue: NotificationBell fetches /notifications/unread every 30 seconds via setInterval even when the menu is closed
findings.impact: Persistent polling on mobile drains battery and consumes data. Multiple open tabs each poll independently.
findings.fix: Clear the interval when document.hidden or when the window loses focus; re-establish when visible again.

findings.issue: ThreadPanel fires an API call to fetch thread metadata on every mount but also on every replies.length change
findings.impact: Each thread open and each new reply triggers a redundant API call even when data was available in parent props.
findings.fix: Derive participant info from existing allMessages/reactions data when possible; only fetch thread metadata once per session.

findings.issue: Sentry.init() is called at module level in layout.tsx, not guarded by env check
findings.impact: Sentry JS bundle is always downloaded and initialized on every page load regardless of environment, adding ~30KB to initial bundle.
findings.fix: Guard Sentry import/init behind a dynamic import that only loads when NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN is set.
